trickyParts: The browser harness survived this pod but not the last one. It is rebuilt by /legion/scratch/harness/setup.sh, recorded verbatim with env.sh in comment 6a00901c-b262-4c0e-946f-3ad9ab38bd54 on dispatch://INFRA-728. Postgres 17 with pgvector at 127.0.0.1:55432, data under /legion/scratch/harness/pgdata; DATABASE_URL carries LEGION_ROLE, so each role gets its own database; e2e/run.ts chooses every other port itself.
Rebuild the SPA (bun run build:web) after every web/src change, including each control's mutation and its restore: the rows serve web/dist.

Control 1's regression is a race. It failed 2 of 40 in round 1, 0 of 40 for the tester and 2 of 80 here, in batches of 0, 0, 2, 0. Budget 80 runs for it, and read VersionView.test.tsx's 'keeps its editor when the parent renders again with an equal highlight' as the deterministic lock.
deviations: The review offered two ways to make the status half of the clear-preview case bite: answer an { error } first, or drop the status half from the case and its title. I took the first, as a second case rather than a longer one, because the preview half and the status half cannot both be dirty at once - show() always empties one when it fills the other - so one case cannot lock both.

The round-1 Thermo line's skip reason for routing blockId through request was wrong, as the review says. The PR body now records the finding as applied in round 2 and names the error rather than hiding it.
discoveredComplexity: request() sends Content-Type: application/json on the GET that blockId's raw fetch did not. The server ignores it on a GET and all four projects pass, so the move is behaviour-preserving in practice.
